(2) A couple is shown in bed; the woman lies awake with her eyes open while the man sleeps beside her. The room is dimly lit with soft indoor light. (3) In a living room, a woman stands near a sofa and throws a grey pillow at a man who is sitting on the floor. He raises his arms to block the pillow. The setting is a modern indoor living room with a grey sofa and neutral decor. (4) Back to the woman in the checkered shirt at the desk. She uses both hands to emphasize her points, holding up one finger and then two as she categorizes information. (5) A woman with long hair sits at a glass desk in a home office, working on a laptop. The lighting is low and cinematic. (6) A man is vacuuming a grey rug in a bright, modern kitchen and living area, while a woman stands in the background leaning against a counter and looking at her smartphone. (7) A man and a woman sit on a sofa. The woman gestures animatedly while talking to the man, who sits with his hand on his chin, looking contemplative or distressed. An illustrated purple owl wearing a graduation cap is superimposed at the bottom right corner.

(6) [Subtitle]: 然後一張眼醒來就有各式各樣的瑣事要處理. (7) [Subtitle]: 事情真的很容易變得很難多很容易吵架. (8) [Subtitle]: 黃乙白的伴侶課程裡面呢. (9) [Subtitle]: 把家長的關係分成三種. (10) [Subtitle]: 我真的覺得蠻傳神的齁. (11) [Subtitle]: 大家可以聽聽看.
